english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for conspicuous pomp or showy display, especially at a public event.

exampleSentences.english: That awards ceremony had a lot of glitz and the whole scene was eye-catching.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰個頒獎禮搞到好有排場，成個場面都好搶眼。

english.note: Use this when the opulence means a conspicuous show of wealth, pomp, or luxury.

exampleSentences.english: The opulence of this wedding banquet is absurd.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次婚宴擺咁大排場，真係有錢到離譜。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 fan1 jin3 baai2 gam3 daai6 paai4 coeng2 zan1 hai6 jau5 cin2 dou3 lei4 pou2

english.note: Use 排場 when parade means a showy or ostentatious display rather than a literal procession.

exampleSentences.english: They put on quite a parade for the shop opening.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋為咗間舖頭開張，擺足排場。
